blocks.raw: We are super excited to announce the launch of our Health Savings Account (HSA) **investing** account. With this new account [type](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/enums#account-type), customers will be able to use HSA funds to make investments in their HSA account; to use towards furture medical expenses. We are offering the flowing investment flows for HSA accounts: Self directed, Robo Advisory, and Managed. To learn more about these different types of investment flows, [see here](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/enums).
blocks.text: We are super excited to announce the launch of our Health Savings Account (HSA) investing account. With this new account type, customers will be able to use HSA funds to make investments in their HSA account; to use towards furture medical expenses. We are offering the flowing investment flows for HSA accounts: Self directed, Robo Advisory, and Managed. To learn more about these different types of investment flows, see here.

blocks.raw: In order to get started with HSA accounts, please contact your relations manager or email us directly at [RMteam@drivewealth.com](mailto:rmteam@drivewealth.com). Please be aware this account type is only for U.S. residents whom have a valid social security number.

blocks.raw: We are now introducing a feature where users that trying to be onboarded from a [non active country](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/get_countries), the user is automatically rejected from being created on the platform.

blocks.raw: We enhanced our [asset transfer](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/post_asset-transfers-acats) api. Starting this release, if an incorrect DTCC code known as `clearingNo` is passed; we will now reject the api request.
blocks.text: We enhanced our asset transfer api. Starting this release, if an incorrect DTCC code known as clearingNo is passed; we will now reject the api request.

blocks.raw: We enhanced the ability to send users to phsyical document review if the user is living in the United State but has a citizenship in a DOC country list.
blocks.text: We enhanced the ability to send users to phsyical document review if the user is living in the United State but has a citizenship in a DOC country list.

blocks.raw: We had an issue with [One Settlement](https://developer.drivewealth.com/apis/reference/get_settlements-settlementid). When settlement reports finished processing they would stay in `PENDING` and not move into a `SUCCESSFUL` state. We corrected that issue with this release.
